description: Read-only. Fetch quarterly figures for one company — optionally narrowed to a single parameter and a quarter range. Pass a `companyId` from `bolagsanalys_list_companies` and (optionally) a `parameterCode` from `bolagsanalys_find_parameter`. Quarter bounds use packed ids: `quarterId`, `fromDate`, `toDate` accept e.g. '20251' or '2025Q1' (these are QUARTERS, not calendar dates). Example: companyId 'SE-VOLV-B', parameterCode 'REV', fromDate '2024Q1', toDate '2025Q4'. Every row keeps its `companyId` and `parameterCode`; read-only — never writes.

companyId.description: Company id from bolagsanalys_list_companies, e.g. 'SE-VOLV-B'. Omit to fetch ALL companies for the parameter/quarter (enables one-call ranking/aggregation).

count.description: false (default) skips totalCount for cheaper bulk paging.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower quarter bound, e.g. '20241' or '2024Q1'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

parameterCode.description: Parameter code from bolagsanalys_find_parameter; omit for all parameters.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

toDate.description: Inclusive upper quarter bound, e.g. '20254' or '2025Q4'.

name: bolagsanalys_get_data

data.description: Quarterly figures, one row per company+parameter+quarter.

companyId.description: The company this figure belongs to (identity-preserving).

figure.description: Numeric value, when the parameter is numeric.

parameterCode.description: The parameter this figure belongs to.

text.description: Text value, when the parameter is textual.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: Get Bolagsanalys quarterly figures
